name: @pipeworx/mcp-montreal-events

tools.name: events
tools.description: Find upcoming public events in Montréal, Canada. Filter by keyword, borough (arrondissement, e.g. "Ville-Marie", "Le Plateau-Mont-Royal") and date window. Returns events sorted by start date. Content is in French.

query.description: Keyword over title and description, e.g. "musique", "festival", "famille".

from.description: Include events ending on/after this date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

to.description: Include events starting on/before this date YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-montreal-events forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the montreal-events pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
